title: Harnack Theory and Rigidity for Singular and Degenerate Fully Nonlinear Elliptic Equations with Hamiltonians
summary: We study regularity, Harnack inequalities, Liouville rigidity, and principal eigenvalues for viscosity solutions of singular or degenerate fully nonlinear elliptic equations $Φ(x,|\nabla u|)F(D^2u)-H(x,\nabla u)+c(x)|u|^{i(Φ)}u=h(x)$ in a bounded domain $Ω$, where $Φ$ describes the singular or degenerate dependence on the gradient and $H$ is a Hamiltonian. We first prove global $C^{1,γ}$ regularity for the Dirichlet problem without lower-order terms.
